assertions.name: binding_scalar_is_bar_even
assertions.source: Σ_λ a^odd_λ = 0 (bar-odd projection of the binding coefficient vector sums to zero) ⇒ the A=2 binding scalar Σ a_λ = tr_M is bar-even ⇒ bar-symmetric Δ_λ ansätze are NOT structurally excluded

assertions.name: even_projection_recovers_trM
assertions.source: Σ_λ a^even_λ = tr_M (the full binding scalar lives in the bar-even subspace)

description: Bar-parity decomposition of the deuteron binding coefficient vector a_λ = y_λ·χ^λ(β_D) under the partition involution λ↔λ'. Tests whether the 2.6e-4 bar-conjugate-law breaking structurally (scope-b) excludes bar-symmetric Δ_λ ansätze. Finding: the bar-odd projection sums to exactly 0, so the A=2 binding scalar Σ a_λ = tr_M is a purely bar-EVEN functional; a bar-symmetric Δ_λ (uniform δ, dim/hook ansätze) satisfies binding with zero obstruction. The 2.6e-4 is a q↔q⁻¹ decay-sector effect, not a λ↔λ' binding-sector constraint. No scope-(b) exclusion exists; the six refuted ansätze stay scope-(a) numerical. Audit-only, not a closure ansatz (Δ_λ gate).
